name: sr-v2-cloudflare
description: Funil Serasa sr-v2 — Cloudflare Pages Functions (MangoFy)

scripts.dev: node sync-public.mjs && wrangler pages dev public
scripts.deploy: node sync-public.mjs && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name sr-v2 --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:preview: node sync-public.mjs && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name sr-v2-preview --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:stg: node sync-public.mjs && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name sr-v2-stg --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy && npm run deploy:preview && npm run deploy:stg
